clauses.reason: The sole clause amends section 104(b)(1) of EO 11157 to its two-hours-of-aerial-flight form. Under the strike-and-insert ruling it continued, amended, until the parent order ended. EO 13294 of March 28, 2003, Sec. 2, revoked the parent: Executive Order 11157 of June 22, 1964, as amended, "are hereby revoked." (68 FR 15917). EO 13294 has no delayed effective date, and no held later instrument restated section 104 before that.

research_rationale:
EO 11728 (July 12, 1973) amended section 104(b)(1) of EO 11157 (incentive pay for hazardous duty involving aerial flight) to require 2 hours of aerial flight in a calendar month, with carry-over of hours flown in the preceding five months. Under the strike-and-insert ruling of 2026-10-21 an amendment continues, amended, until the parent order ends. EO 11157 of June 22, 1964, as amended, was revoked by EO 13294 of March 28, 2003 (Sec. 2), which also delegates the underlying statutory authority (37 U.S.C. 301, 301a and 301c) to the Secretaries. The status is NO: the parent order carrying the amended section 104(b)(1) was revoked on March 28, 2003.

savings.reason: The held text of EO 13294 revokes EO 11157, as amended, without a savings clause preserving section 104(b)(1); its Sec. 3 is only a no-private-rights provision, and its Sec. 1 delegates the statutory authority to the Secretaries instead. Bounded searches of the U.S. Code, eCFR and OFR catalog found no continuing reliance on EO 11728.
